vertebrae.cache.artifact_store
==============================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.cache.artifact_store

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Artifact store protocols and configuration.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.cache.artifact_store.ArtifactStoreConfig
   vertebrae.cache.artifact_store.ArtifactStore


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: ArtifactStoreConfig

   Serializable artifact-store configuration.

   .. attribute:: uri

      Artifact store URI or local path.

   .. attribute:: options

      Provider-specific options used to reconstruct the store.


.. py:class:: ArtifactStore

   Bases: :py:obj:`Protocol`


   Protocol for embedding and metadata artifact stores.


   .. py:method:: config()

      Return a serializable configuration for this store.



   .. py:method:: exists(key)

      Return whether an artifact exists for a key.



   .. py:method:: put_array(key, arr)

      Store a dense or sparse array artifact and return its URI/path.



   .. py:method:: get_array(key)

      Load a dense or sparse array artifact by key.



   .. py:method:: put_array_batches(key, batches, n_samples, require_complete = True)

      Store arrays from deterministic batches and return their URI/path.



   .. py:method:: put_labels(key, labels)

      Store labels and return their URI/path.



   .. py:method:: get_labels(key)

      Load labels by key.



   .. py:method:: put_json(key, obj)

      Store a JSON metadata artifact and return its URI/path.



   .. py:method:: get_json(key)

      Load a JSON metadata artifact by key.
